title: Criminal Background Check
description: An employment background screening report from a consumer reporting agency, as an adjudication or HR compliance pipeline reads it: who was screened, the overall result, which searches were run, and the detail of each criminal record found.

report.description: Report-level details from the header band and the requested-by block.

screening_provider.description: The consumer reporting agency that produced the report, from its logo or requestor name, e.g. 'Accurate Background'.

overall_result.description: The overall adjudication result shown in the header, exactly as printed, e.g. 'Does Not Meet Requirements'.

ordered_date.description: The date the report was ordered ('ordered on'), exactly as printed (MM/DD/YYYY).

updated_date.description: The date the report was last updated ('updated on'), exactly as printed (MM/DD/YYYY).

requestor.description: The requesting client account, from REQUESTOR.

package.description: The screening package ordered, from PACKAGE.

position_location.description: The location of the position the candidate applied for, from POSITION LOCATION.

client_note.description: The client's instruction note, from CLIENT NOTE.

name.description: The candidate's name exactly as printed in the NAME field (Last, First).

ssn.description: SSN exactly as printed, including any masking.

address.description: The full address as printed, lines joined with commas.

searches.description: Every row of the SEARCHES summary table, in order.

search.description: The search name with any qualifier as printed, e.g. 'COUNTY CRIMINAL - PLACER COUNTY, CA'.

status.description: The status or result printed beside it, e.g. 'COMPLETED' or 'RECORD FOUND'.

criminal_searches.description: Each criminal search detail section (e.g. COUNTY CRIMINAL), with its case files.

jurisdiction.description: STATE/COUNTY exactly as printed, e.g. 'CA / PLACER'.

cases.description: Each CASE FILE in the section.

identified_by.description: The identifiers checked under IDENTIFIED BY, e.g. 'NAME', 'SSN'.

charges.description: Each numbered charge in the case.

charge_number.description: The charge NUMBER as printed, e.g. '#1'.

disposition_date.description: Charge Disposition Date exactly as printed (MM/DD/YYYY).

sentence.description: The CHARGE SENTENCING block. Use null for any item not printed.

jail.description: JAIL term as printed, e.g. '2 HOURS'.

prison.description: PRISON term as printed, e.g. '12 YEARS'.

fines.description: FINES amount exactly as printed, with $ and commas.

fees.description: FEES amount exactly as printed, with $ and commas.

costs.description: COSTS amount exactly as printed, with $ and commas.

restitution.description: RESTITUTION amount exactly as printed, with $ and commas.

classes.description: CLASSES ordered or completed, as printed.
